headline: EU sets limits on imports of hybrid cars from China, Mexico and other countries
summary: The European Union has set maximum limits on hybrid vehicle imports from China, Japan, Turkey, the United Kingdom and other countries. The measure aims to protect EU carmakers.
why: Automotive trade between the EU and Asian producers is a major source of competition for European carmakers. Import quotas can reshape pricing and market share in the region.
original_headline: La UE pone límites a las importaciones de autos híbridos de China, México y otros países
